format.array: several boxes — press Z to advance

intro:
Welcome, apprentice mechanic.
The Hub King sleeps, and every robot has stopped.

To wake him you must first know
the Six Spirits. Look closely.
afterCards:
Now you know their names.
Press X any time to open the codex.

Next, the blacksmith.
Go learn about beams and pins.
gran.repeat:
The codex is on X.
Open it whenever you're unsure.

intro:
A robot's bones are BEAMS,
and the nails that join them are PINS.

Tell pins apart by colour.
Black and blue feel rough — they grip. For locking!

Light grey and beige feel smooth — they spin.
Use those for wheels and joints.
afterCards:
Axles tell their length by colour:
odd = grey, even = black, and only the 2-long is red.

And never pry parts with your nails.
Use the SEPARATOR. That's a craftsman's manner.

The gatekeeper will test you.
Go on.
smith.repeat:
Black and blue lock.
Grey and beige spin. Don't forget.

guard.passed:
You pass. Take the south gate.
The maker is waiting in the workshop.
guard.notReady:
You're not ready yet.
See the granny and the blacksmith first.
guard.challenge:
None pass this gate untested.
Three questions. Ready?

altar:
A huge hub lies dormant.
All 25 lights are dark.

Six ports, A through F.
Not one of them is connected…
sign:
" Hub Village "
Arrows — move / Z·Enter — talk / X — codex

South gate → Assembly Workshop
Learn from the villagers first.

maker.find:
You need seven things.
Pull out what matches the picture.
maker.motor:
Two kinds of holes — cross and round.
An axle only fits the cross one.
maker.beam:
Black pins feel rough — they don't turn.
Stiff is normal. That's the point.
maker.flag: Shape is up to you. It's your golem.
maker.cable:
The body is done. Now the lifeline.
Port A. Read the letter with your eyes.
maker.code:
Read the spell book on the right
and copy it into the SPIKE app.
maker.afterDone:
The north door is open.
Head to the Teardown Room.
finish:
You did it.
The golem waves its flag, just as you wrote!

But one gate remains.
Go north — the Teardown Room.

late.find:
If finding parts takes this long, the rest gets tight.
Call me if you're stuck.
late.motor: Don't force it. Changing the angle is faster.
late.beam: Press with your thumb until it clicks.
late.flag: Any shape works. Let's move on.
late.cable: Did you read the port letter? It's A.
late.code: The block colour tells you which drawer.

workshop.bench:
A workbench. Parts are laid out neatly.
This is where you build the real robot.

hubroom.altarLocked:
The Hub King still sleeps.
Tangled cables coil around him…
hubroom.altarAwake:
…Thank you, apprentice mechanic.
Brixity moves again!

battle.appear:
{name} appeared!
Answer correctly to drive it back!
battle.revive:
The spirits lend you their strength!
Try again.

opening:
The robot kingdom of Brixity.
Every machine here ran on the Hub King at its centre.

Then one day tangled cables coiled around him
and the 5x5 eyes went dark.

A kingdom stopped. One hope remains —
the apprentice mechanic who started today. You.

Learn the parts, build with your own hands,
weave the spell — the code — and wake the king.

You have ten minutes.
…Let us begin.
